text:
tablet_felix: Pattern is erratic movement between bed_b1, kitchen_table_k1, and nightstand_b1. Day 6 evidence pointed to bed_b1, but day 7 07:57 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1. Do not assume a single static location; check kitchen_table_k1 first in the morning, then bed_b1 in the evening.

razor_felix: Consistently misidentified as sink_ba_ba1. Day 6 and day 7 07:00 feedback both confirm it is at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Stop checking the sink; always check the shelf for grooming items.

mug_felix: Previously noted as kitchen_table_k1, but day 7 21:54 feedback shows it was at coffee_table_l1. This suggests the mug moves to the living room in the evening. Check coffee_table_l1 for active drinkware after 20:00, rather than assuming it stays in the kitchen.

charger_felix: Day 6 note suggested entry_hook_e1, but day 7 22:59 feedback shows it was at entry_floor_e1. The location is near the entry, but specifically on the floor, not the hook. Check entry_floor_e1 for charging accessories when residents are arriving or leaving.

glass_felix: Day 6 feedback indicated cupboard_k1. No new evidence today, so keep this note. Check cupboard_k1 for drinkware.

water_bottle_felix: Day 6 feedback indicated kitchen_table_k1. No new evidence today, so keep this note. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.

book_felix: Day 6 feedback indicated bed_b1. No new evidence today, so keep this note. Check bed_b1 for reading materials.
